purpose_zh: 把既有 D01—D08 现实替换缺口与 H01—H07 专业证据门转成可现场使用、可保管、可退回、可否决的空白采集合同；不生成任何现场观察、测量、访谈、批准、责任接受或绩效。
purpose_en: Turn the existing D01-D08 replacement gaps and H01-H07 professional gates into an empty, field-usable contract for collection, custody, return and rejection; it creates no field observation, measurement, interview, approval, duty acceptance or performance result.

template_warning.zh: 模板不等于证据；字段完整不等于资料已取得；专业接收不等于批准或成熟度升级。
template_warning.en: A template is not evidence; complete fields do not mean material has been obtained; professional receipt is not approval or a maturity upgrade.

artifact_type_rules.minimum_quality_gate: issuer, authority, issue date, version, exact applicable scope, complete pages and integrity hash are present
artifact_type_rules.privacy_and_rights_gate: record access and reuse terms; redact protected identifiers only on the public copy while retaining a controlled original if lawful
artifact_type_rules.cannot_prove: field conditions, implementation, construction, operation or compliance outside the document's exact scope

artifact_type_rules.minimum_quality_gate: qualified source type, survey date, CRS, precision, method, control basis, coverage and machine-readable geometry are present
artifact_type_rules.privacy_and_rights_gate: remove personal traces and disclose database, survey and redistribution rights
artifact_type_rules.cannot_prove: ownership, statutory status, future condition or accessibility compliance without the relevant professional decision

artifact_type_rules.minimum_quality_gate: capture time field, place-scope field, direction/context, unedited original hash and derivative history are present
artifact_type_rules.privacy_and_rights_gate: no identifiable person, face, plate, private interior or sensitive screen enters public release without an applicable basis and review
artifact_type_rules.cannot_prove: dimension, continuous duration, absence of hazards, ownership, approval or performance beyond the recorded view

artifact_type_rules.minimum_quality_gate: quantity, unit, method, instrument, calibration status, conditions, repetitions, uncertainty and raw-record hash are present
artifact_type_rules.privacy_and_rights_gate: collect only the minimum non-personal value required for the declared decision
artifact_type_rules.cannot_prove: compliance or general performance without a predeclared protocol, denominator and competent review

artifact_type_rules.minimum_quality_gate: participant category, accessible information, voluntary consent, withdrawal route, question version and de-identification method are present
artifact_type_rules.privacy_and_rights_gate: do not publish identity, contact, voice, sensitive narrative or raw transcript by default; safeguarding applies to children and vulnerable groups
artifact_type_rules.cannot_prove: population prevalence, unanimous support, institutional commitment or legal authorization

artifact_type_rules.minimum_quality_gate: task, state axis, start/end event fields, responsible role type, denominator, exception and source system/version are present
artifact_type_rules.privacy_and_rights_gate: aggregate and minimize; public records exclude personal trails and hidden worker surveillance
artifact_type_rules.cannot_prove: service quality, causation, fairness or duty acceptance unless separately evidenced

artifact_type_rules.minimum_quality_gate: competent issuer, exact activity/place/time/version, conditions, expiry, withdrawal and appeal fields are present
artifact_type_rules.privacy_and_rights_gate: publish only the portion authorized for disclosure and preserve a controlled complete record
artifact_type_rules.cannot_prove: construction completion, operational success, rights clearance or permission beyond its stated scope

artifact_type_rules.minimum_quality_gate: before-state packet, affected components, removal/data disposition, after-state record, unresolved harm and independent acceptance fields are linked
artifact_type_rules.privacy_and_rights_gate: retain only necessary incident and responsibility information; public disclosure is de-identified
artifact_type_rules.cannot_prove: automatic restart eligibility, absence of latent harm or acceptance by every affected group

replacement_packet_templates.cannot_prove: approval of this proposal, ownership, buildability, field condition or performance
replacement_packet_templates.replacement_trigger: valid authoritative geometry is accepted for recalculation
replacement_packet_templates.expiry_or_recheck_trigger: superseding issue, scope change, revoked authority or unresolved geometry conflict

replacement_packet_templates.can_prove: dated conditions actually covered by the survey within its stated precision
replacement_packet_templates.cannot_prove: statutory right, structural safety, universal accessibility or conditions outside the survey window
replacement_packet_templates.replacement_trigger: reviewed survey can verify, revise or delete a concept relationship
replacement_packet_templates.expiry_or_recheck_trigger: physical change, incomplete coverage, stale date or incompatible methods

replacement_packet_templates.can_prove: only the rights, controls or decisions expressly stated for the exact scope
replacement_packet_templates.cannot_prove: site approval for this proposal, building condition, fire compliance or future consent
replacement_packet_templates.replacement_trigger: competent review resolves each relevant control and right
replacement_packet_templates.expiry_or_recheck_trigger: control revision, right change, appeal, withdrawal or conflict

replacement_packet_templates.label_zh: 无障碍与同任务公共同权

replacement_packet_templates.cannot_prove: universal accessibility, population-wide acceptance or parity outside the tested task

replacement_packet_templates.expiry_or_recheck_trigger: route, service, interface, user group or task version changes

replacement_packet_templates.label_zh: 交通、高峰与普通通行连续性
replacement_packet_templates.can_prove: dated movement and conflict conditions within the declared counting and coverage limits
replacement_packet_templates.cannot_prove: future demand, statutory road boundary, causation or approved event capacity
replacement_packet_templates.replacement_trigger: reviewed evidence can stress-test and revise ordinary-route protection
replacement_packet_templates.expiry_or_recheck_trigger: network, timetable, season, construction or observation-method change

responsibility_types: applicable railway, heritage, water, ecology, municipal, fire, emergency, structure, lighting or acoustics professional
replacement_packet_templates.can_prove: the competent discipline's finding for the exact reviewed scope
replacement_packet_templates.cannot_prove: all-discipline clearance, construction approval or absence of unreviewed constraints
replacement_packet_templates.replacement_trigger: discipline finding revises, conditions, rejects or deletes the affected concept
replacement_packet_templates.expiry_or_recheck_trigger: design, site, standard, hazard or professional scope changes

replacement_packet_templates.can_prove: accepted duties and resources only for their exact signed scope and validity
replacement_packet_templates.cannot_prove: future availability, volunteer sufficiency, service quality, procurement or site authorization
replacement_packet_templates.replacement_trigger: all required roles and resources are confirmed for a separately authorized envelope
replacement_packet_templates.expiry_or_recheck_trigger: role, contact, shift, budget, scope, labour or authorization change

replacement_packet_templates.can_prove: only the uses explicitly cleared for the identified asset, data and version
replacement_packet_templates.cannot_prove: blanket clearance, field accuracy, endorsement or rights for an unlisted derivative
replacement_packet_templates.replacement_trigger: independent file-level audit closes every applicable use context
replacement_packet_templates.expiry_or_recheck_trigger: asset, terms, owner, use, territory, duration or derivative changes

state_meanings.not_submitted: No artifact has been attached; remain NO-GO.
state_meanings.received_unverified: Material exists but authenticity, integrity, applicability, rights or competence has not closed.
state_meanings.return_for_completion: Required metadata, coverage, rights, denominator or linkage is incomplete; return to the responsible source.
state_meanings.conflict_hold: Sources or professional findings conflict; protect ordinary public rights and pause the affected proof overlay.
state_meanings.professionally_rejected: A competent review finds the material or concept unusable; revise or retire it without altering official evidence.
state_meanings.accepted_for_recalculation: The material may replace a typed placeholder and trigger downstream recalculation; this is not site, planning, construction, operation or G1 approval.
state_meanings.expired: The material is no longer valid for the intended place, time, version or use; return to NO-GO.

peer_method_lineage.borrowed_method_only: make disposition understandable to the public and keep an explicit path for correction, pause and return

normalized_mapping.keep: retain the verified ordinary baseline or public right; never infer that a proof overlay is approved
normalized_mapping.modify: return an incomplete evidence packet for correction or revise the affected concept
normalized_mapping.pause: apply NO-GO or conflict hold and stop the affected proof overlay while ordinary use remains
normalized_mapping.return: return the packet to its responsible source for completion, or restore ordinary use and retire the affected overlay

publication_and_authorization_boundary.professional_veto: Competent evidence may revise, reject or delete the concept. Official evidence must not be altered to preserve the proposal.
